label: Marketplace intelligence
objection_response: It is reasonable to ask how recommendations work without interaction history. Recommendation quality must be evaluated on your products and customers. Which catalogue inputs and success criteria can we review?

next_steps.English: Next step: review available catalogue data and images, confirm the customer experience, and agree a baseline and recommendation evaluation criteria before making implementation commitments.
next_steps.Hindi: अगला कदम: उपलब्ध कैटलॉग डेटा और चित्रों की समीक्षा करें। ग्राहक अनुभव, बेसलाइन और मूल्यांकन मानदंड तय करने के बाद ही इम्प्लीमेंटेशन की प्रतिबद्धता करें।
next_steps.Hinglish: Agla step: available catalogue data aur images review karein. Customer experience, baseline aur evaluation criteria agree karne ke baad implementation commitment dein.
